about: Known points in space and the airspace a pilot should be in there, taken from charts and legal descriptions (never from our own data). scripts/check-airspace.js tests the built data against these every build. Points are airport reference points from the NASR APT_BASE.csv (Oct 29, 2026 cycle) unless noted. Altitudes are feet MSL. 'expect' is one of: { ident, class } (in exactly that airspace), { notIdent } (not in that airport's airspace), { none: true } (in no B/C/D airspace).

checks.name: Moffett/Palo Alto overlap, low: Palo Alto owns it
checks.source: Point 4.0 statute miles from Moffett toward Palo Alto, inside both. Moffett Class D legal description excludes the Palo Alto Class D airspace area (Federal Register doc 98-11856).

checks.name: Moffett/Palo Alto overlap, above Palo Alto's ceiling: Moffett
checks.source: Same point. Palo Alto's Class D tops out at 2,000 or below, Moffett's goes up to but not including 2,500 (Federal Register doc 98-11856).

checks.name: Moffett/Palo Alto overlap at exactly Palo Alto's ceiling: Moffett
checks.source: This point is in Palo Alto's 1,500 ft sector, which goes up to but not including 1,500 (NASR). Moffett's Class D covers everything above Palo Alto's up to 2,500 (Federal Register doc 98-11856), so 1,500 itself is Moffett's.
